verses: His Augustness Kamu-nuna-kaha-mimi dwelt at the palace of Takawoka in Kadzuraki, and ruled the Empire. This Heavenly Sovereign wedded Kaha-mata-bime, ancestress of the Departmental Lords of Shiki, and begot an august child: His Augustness Shiki-tsu-hiko-tama-demi one Deity, The Heavenly Sovereign's august years were forty-five. His august mausoleum is on the Mound of Tsukida.
